👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `b12d760`: all 47 files reviewed.

10 finding(s): 6 to fix, 4 to consider; 10 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 6.** Part 1 has one finding. The Ready lookup and the one-click 'open existing' path key on the preset alone. The vertical and square fingerprint does not include Fill / Fit, so a Fit copy is shown as Ready, and opened, when Fill is selected. Also recorded as a contract only, because the change is in library-page.tsx (another part): with the Library's useFileDrop removed and no will-navigate guard in main, a file dropped outside Export falls through to Electron's default of navigating the window to the file, not 'doing nothing' as the PR body says. The Email destination, the redirects, the path helpers and the keyboard handling read as correct.

**Batch 2 of 6.** I reviewed the five files in part 2 and found two "fix" issues and one "consider".

- **Library drops (fix, high confidence):** the Library no longer handles files dropped on the window, and nothing in the main process blocks navigation. Dropping a video there now makes Electron navigate the window to the file. The PR says that drop "does nothing".
- **Crop illustration (fix, medium confidence):** the before/after crops of small text now appear for TikTok · Reels and LinkedIn · Feeds. Those copies are no larger than 1080p, so the illustration promises sharper text they won't have. Before, the crops were YouTube-only.
- **Picker focus (consider):** closing the video picker doesn't return focus to its trigger.

I found nothing to flag in the GitHub size bar, the recent-exports strip or the picker's open/close handling.

**Batch 3 of 6.** I found nothing to flag in the seven files of this part.

- **Deleted Prepare files:** nothing still references `destination-list.tsx`, `prepare-drop-zone.tsx` or `prepare-page.tsx`. Their logic (`isPrimaryEnter`, `usePrepareImport`) now lives in `pages/export/export-page.tsx`.
- **Sidebar badge:** the new Export badge counts a running export plus finished copies the user hasn't been shown yet. It doesn't count the same export twice, because the runner's "ready" value is empty while an export is running. It clears on both /export and /library, and its label text exists in English and Spanish.
- **Tests:** the new `use-file-drop.test.tsx` checks the same drag-and-drop behaviours the deleted `import-drop-zone.test.tsx` did. The `destinations.test.ts` changes correctly handle email sharing chat's "balanced" preset, so a "balanced" file still reads as the chat copy.

One problem sits in another part's file, so it is recorded in contracts rather than as a finding. `library-page.tsx` no longer handles file drops, and I found no guard in the main process that blocks navigation. The drop hook's own comment says an unhandled drop makes Electron load the dropped file in the window, so dropping a file on the Library page probably navigates away instead of importing it. Whoever reviews `library-page.tsx` should confirm this.

**Batch 4 of 6.** I reviewed the three test files in part 4 and found two problems, both in `library-page.test.tsx`; the other two files have nothing to flag. The new Export tests check what their names say, and the Library-detail tests only change the expected path from `/prepare` to `/export`. First, the new \"does not take a video dropped on the window\" test cannot fail: the test setup's default `pathForFile` returns \"\", so a dropped file would be skipped before `importVideoFiles` is called either way. Second, the behavior that test pins is a regression. The Library no longer handles drops and main has no `will-navigate` guard, so a file dropped on the Library likely makes Electron load that file in place of the app. That rests on the repo's own comment in `use-file-drop.ts`; I could not check Electron's runtime behavior, so confidence is medium.

**Batch 5 of 6.** I reviewed the 8 files in part 5 and found nothing to fix, only two optional test improvements for `sidebar.test.tsx`; nothing was built or run, only read.

**Two optional test improvements (`sidebar.test.tsx`)**
- **Line 39:** the test is named "is active on Export with and without a video", but it only renders `/export/asset-1`. Nothing checks that the Export item is lit on the bare `/export` page. A second render of `ROUTES.exportNew` with the same check, or a rename, would fix it.
- **Line 48:** the badge now counts a copy still being made, but every test only feeds it finished copies. If the "in progress" count drifts, the rail shows a wrong number and no test fails.

**What I checked and found fine**
- **Deleted Prepare tests:** each Prepare scenario has a matching test in `export-page.test.tsx`. That includes the drop-import cases, the Enter key, the busy and unreadable-file cases, and the old Prepare URLs.
- **Stylesheets:** every CSS variable the new files use is defined, either in `packages/tokens/css/tokens.css` or in `assets/base.css`. The `send-more` and `keep-light` colour hooks match the values `groupOf()` returns.
- **Email logo:** it gets its own colour for the new email destination.
- **Removed `import-drop-zone.module.css`:** its component is deleted elsewhere in this pull request.

**Batch 6 of 6.** I reviewed part 6 of #73: routes, the window-size test, Export/Library stylesheets, the backlog docs, and the en/es messages. The new `export` i18n keys exist in both locales, and the renderer uses every one of them, through literal `t()` calls or the key maps in `export-copy.ts`, `export-stage.tsx` and `destination-copy.ts`. The Library keys that were removed have no remaining users. Every class `export-stage.tsx` uses is defined in the rewritten `export-stage.module.css`.

There are two findings:
- **Fix (bug):** with `useFileDrop` gone from the Library and no `will-navigate` guard in main, a file dropped on the Library navigates the Electron window to that file. The backlog doc and the PR's test plan say the drop "does nothing".
- **Consider (cleanup):** `library-page.module.css:108` still has the comment for the deleted `.importZone` rule.

One contract is open: whether the legacy `/prepare` redirect keeps `?to=`. That logic is in `router.tsx`, which belongs to another part, and I did not check it.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (20 closed, 1 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Open: the reviewer could not close these**
- New routes /export/:assetId and /export, with /prepare and /prepare/:assetId kept as legacy redirects (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:18`) — Does the router's redirect actually keep the query string (?to=) for both legacy routes? The router is in another part. Files that would answer it: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts`.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- Export with an Email destination passes `destination` to usePrepareCopy and on to the export job (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:252-260`) — The progress and ready cards call destinationArg(job). With 'email', the ICU select falls back to 'your export', as the PR body says. JobIcon shows the Mail logo. If it fails: If an export is already running, the busy toast shows and start returns false. ExportScreen ignores that return value, which is fine because the toast is visible. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:98-128`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:55-66`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destination-logo.tsx:21`. ⚠️ A citation did not resolve in the head.
- Window-wide file drop on Export (usePrepareImport → useFileDrop), and the Library no longer taking drops (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:85`) — Export opens on the first imported video. A toast names the others. If it fails: useFileDrop is now mounted only by usePrepareImport, and the main process has no will-navigate guard (only setWindowOpenHandler). On every other page, including the Library, the default for a dropped… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:42-56`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400-403`.
- Source probe while the Export page reads the video ('Reading…') (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:92-99`) — While the probe runs the page shows 'Reading…'. On error it shows the toast and then the drop zone. If it fails: probeSource never throws (it catches and returns null), but nothing puts a timeout on the sequential mediabunny awaits. A kaipu-media fetch that never answers leaves 'Reading…' on screen indefinitely… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/probe-source.ts:28-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-67`.
- The chosen-destination ref and remounts (Change video, Back) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:77-88`) — Change video keeps the selection through the URL. Back restores the earlier ?to=. If it fails: A selection made on the screen is not written to the URL, so leaving and coming back through the rail loses it. The screen then shows 'Where is it going?', which is harmless. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:150-163`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:212`.
- Legacy /prepare redirect (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:168-173`) — Old URLs land on Export. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts:12-15`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx:68-74`.
- Library stops installing the window-wide file drop handler (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:53`) — Electron navigates the main window to the dropped file, replacing the app UI. If it fails: No main-process will-navigate guard exists, so nothing intercepts it. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:29-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400`.
- DestinationStage renders the upload-size card, framing choice and crop illustration for every send-more destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:93`) — The card says the copy will have sharper text than a 1080p upload. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:252-257`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:271-283`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:230-258`.
- SizeBarCard scales GitHub's bar against the 10 MB free limit (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:296`) — The tag says it fits the limit or is over it, and the bar width is clamped to 3-100%. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:202-203`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:311-324`.
- RecentExports reads the export runner and lists the running job plus the newest copies (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/recent-exports.tsx:34`) — The progress percentage updates from the runner's progress messages; a finished row opens /library/:id. If it fails: On a runner error, status leaves 'exporting', so the running row disappears and no error shows here (the status cards handle it). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:26-27`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:418`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:112`.
- VideoPicker opens a list of originals; Escape or an outside mousedown closes it (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/video-picker.tsx:45`) — A pick navigates to /export/:id with the current destination. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/tags/tag-chip.tsx:44`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:86-88`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:364`.
- Rail badge moves from Library to the new Export item; the count is now 1 for a running export plus the finished copies not yet announced (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111`) — The Export rail item shows the badge, labelled with export.railBadge ('# copy in progress or ready'), and it exists in both en and es. When an export finishes, noteFinishedCopy changes `copies`, so the effect runs again. If the user is on Export or Library at that moment, the co… If it fails: A failed export (status 'error') adds nothing to the count. The store lives in memory only, so a relaunch clears it, which is the documented behaviour. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:50-75`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:26`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:321-326`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:462`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:17-20`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`, `packages/i18n/messages/es.json:946`.
- Library's window-wide file drop is removed (the deleted ImportDropZone test covered the Library wiring); drops are now caught only while the Export page is mou… (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.test.tsx:1`) — Out of scope for this part (library-page.tsx): useFileDrop's own comment says a file dropped where nothing handles it makes Electron navigate the window to that file. No will-navigate guard was found in src/main, so a file dropped on Library now navigates away instead of importi… If it fails: If no handler is mounted, the platform default takes the drop and the window navigates to file://. The reviewer of library-page.tsx should confirm this. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:40-58`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:55`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:1-33`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400`.
- Email is added as a destination that uses chat's 'balanced' preset; the tests are updated (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.test.ts:36`) — Existing 'balanced' files read as the chat copy on 'Already prepared'. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:37-73`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:102-107`.
- A file dropped on the window while the Library is open (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.test.tsx:80`) — On Export the drop imports and opens the video. On the Library nothing in the renderer handles it. If it fails: The default drop action is not prevented and main has no will-navigate guard, so Electron navigates the main window to the file (per the use-file-drop comment). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:40-51`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:54-56`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400-403`.
- Test: a dropped video on Export is imported and opened with the destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:460`) — The route changes to /export/<new>?to=<dest>, and extra imports are named in a toast. If it fails: run catches a rejection and reports it through reportError; busy.current blocks concurrent imports. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-import-videos.ts:76-115`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:42-52`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts:12-15`.
- Test: old /prepare URLs redirect to /export, keeping the query (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:374`) — Export opens with the same ?to= destination. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:168-173`.
- Rail Export entry badge: running export + unannounced finished copies; cleared on visiting Export or Library (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shell/sidebar.test.tsx:44`) — The badge count and the railBadge plural label on the Export rail item. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:79-81`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`.
- Deleted PreparePage tests; coverage moved to ExportPage tests (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/prepare/prepare-page.test.tsx:1`) — Each Prepare scenario has an Export counterpart: destinations, YouTube 1440p/4K, Enter key, GitHub 10 MB, Reels fit/fill, archive, busy, unreadable file, screenshots, Ready copy, edits warning, drops (single, multiple, non-video), and old Prepare URLs. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:132-372`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:374-382`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:419-511`.
- New stylesheet selectors for the destination row, header and email logo (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/destination-row.module.css:102`) — Card sizes are coloured by the legend tone. The email logo gets its own background. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:48`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:55-57`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/destination-row.tsx:107`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/assets/base.css:72`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/assets/base.css:74`, `packages/tokens/css/tokens.css:24`, `packages/tokens/css/tokens.css:16`.
- Library stops mounting the window-wide file drop handler; a file dragged from the OS onto the Library window (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/export-screen.md:50`) — The main window navigates to the dropped file (file:// video) and the app UI disappears. If it fails: No error and no state tells the user. The session's UI is lost until a reload. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:29-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.test.tsx:81`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.test.tsx:86`.
